title: Booking a Hotel Room: A Quick Guide
description: Join our friendly hosts as they walk you through the simple steps of booking a hotel room— from choosing dates to final confirmation. Perfect for travelers new to online reservations or anyone needing a refresher!
thumbnailPrompt: A cozy studio with warm orange lighting, two people chatting over a laptop on a plush sofa, text overlay: "Booking a Hotel Room" in stylish font.

scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.imagePrompt: A dimly lit studio with a dark purple backdrop and warm orange accents, two hosts seated on a sofa facing the camera.

audio.text: Hey everyone! Welcome back to our travel podcast. Today we’re diving into how to book a hotel room without any hassle.

scenes.title: Step 1: Pick Your Dates
scenes.imagePrompt: A close‑up of a laptop screen showing a calendar with dates highlighted, a coffee mug in the corner.

audio.text: First things first—choose your travel dates. Open your favorite booking site or app and pick the check‑in and check‑out days that fit your itinerary.

scenes.title: Step 2: Filter & Compare
scenes.imagePrompt: Screen split showing two hotel listings side by side with price tags, star ratings, and a filter panel on the left.

audio.text: Next, use filters to narrow down options—price range, amenities, or location. Compare a few rooms, read reviews, and make sure it meets your needs.

scenes.title: Step 3: Read the Fine Print
scenes.imagePrompt: A hand scrolling through a hotel policy page on a tablet, highlighting cancellation terms.

audio.text: Before you hit confirm, read the fine print. Check cancellation policies, extra fees, and any room restrictions to avoid surprises later.

scenes.title: Step 4: Confirm & Celebrate
scenes.imagePrompt: A celebratory scene with confetti animation over a laptop screen showing a booking confirmation page.

audio.text: All set! Hit that confirm button, enter your payment details, and you’re booked. Grab the confirmation email—your travel adventure starts soon!
